_doc: #387 — the ROTATION half of the weapon-shape matrix. A NEW fixture, deliberately beside
`weapon_shapes.json` rather than inside it: that file is settled evidence about ONE facing and stays
untouched, while this one adds a dimension it never covered. `weapon_shapes.json` remains the single home
of the zone-kind DESCRIPTORS and the category → zone ASSIGNMENTS; this file holds only per-facing cell
sets, keyed by the same zone-kind names. The one overlap (the `east` row is the same geometry that file
already pins) is not a second home: both twin tests assert the two files agree on it, so a drift is a
WHY ROTATION IS ITS OWN DIMENSION: a directional zone is drawn around the attacker→target axis, so proving
a staff sweeps three cells while the attacker faces EAST proves nothing about the other three facings.
Six conditions are pinned: the four cardinals, a DIAGONAL aim (|dx| ties |dy| — both twins must break the
tie to the x axis), and a target on the board's LAST COLUMN (the forward step and the inline second cell
fall off the grid and must be DROPPED, never wrapped to x=0 nineteen columns away).
PROVENANCE: derived from the ruled geometry alone (cell = y*20 + x, GRID_W 20 / GRID_H 19) — not read out
of either twin, so agreeing with these vectors is evidence rather than a tautology. Both halves assert this
file: packages/sim/test/weapon_shapes.test.js through the sim's `get_aoe_cells`, and
compared as SETS — exact membership AND exact size, so 'and nothing outside' is part of every row.
